import os
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import kendalltau, spearmanr, rankdata

os.environ.setdefault("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "0")

import matplotlib

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROJECT_ROOT = Path("/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias")
OUTPUT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "artifacts" / "bootstrap_results"
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Default MODEL_NAMES for N=8 backward compat (overridden by idata if available)
MODEL_NAMES_N8 = [
    "gemma-2-9b", "gpt-3.5-turbo-0125", "gpt-4-0613", "gpt-4o",
    "gpt-4o-mini", "llama-3.3-70b", "qwen2.5-72b", "qwen3-8b",
]

# Full Arena Elo (covers both N=8 and N=17 models)
ARENA_ELO = {
    "gpt-4o": 1300,
    "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022": 1298,
    "gpt-4o-mini": 1286,
    "llama-3.3-70b": 1275,
    "gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09": 1272,
    "qwen2.5-72b": 1269,
    "claude-3-opus-20240229": 1262,
    "llama-3.1-70b-instruct": 1261,
    "gemma-2-27b-it": 1231,
    "llama-3-70b-instruct": 1221,
    "gemma-2-9b": 1207,
    "gpt-4-0314": 1206,
    "claude-3-haiku-20240307": 1195,
    "gpt-4-0613": 1186,
    "qwen3-8b": 1170,
    "llama-3-8b-instruct": 1166,
    "mixtral-8x22b-instruct-v0.1": 1162,
    "gpt-3.5-turbo-0125": 1125,
}

ARENA_NAME_MAPPING = {
    "gemma-2-9b-it": "gemma-2-9b",
    "gpt-4o-2024-05-13": "gpt-4o",
    "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18": "gpt-4o-mini",
    "claude-3-5-sonnet": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
    "llama-3.1-70b": "llama-3.1-70b-instruct",
    "llama-3-70b": "llama-3-70b-instruct",
    "llama-3-8b": "llama-3-8b-instruct",
    "mixtral-8x22b": "mixtral-8x22b-instruct-v0.1",
}

EXCLUDE_MODELS = ["qwen3-8b"]


def compute_ranking(values):
    """Descending rank: highest value = rank 1."""
    return rankdata(-np.asarray(values), method="ordinal")


def main():
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Load posterior theta samples (data-driven model list)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    ppc_path = PROJECT_ROOT / "exp003" / "output_003b" / "joint_gmfrm_idata_with_ppc.nc"
    base_path = PROJECT_ROOT / "exp003" / "output_003b" / "joint_gmfrm_idata.nc"
    nc_path = ppc_path if ppc_path.exists() else base_path
    print(f"Loading InferenceData: {nc_path}")
    idata = az.from_netcdf(str(nc_path))

    theta_samples = idata.posterior["theta"].values
    n_chains, n_draws, n_models = theta_samples.shape

    n_total = theta_flat.shape[0]

    if "model" in idata.posterior.coords:
        MODEL_NAMES = [str(m) for m in idata.posterior.coords["model"].values]
        print(f"  Model names from idata: {MODEL_NAMES}")
    elif n_models == 8:
        MODEL_NAMES = MODEL_NAMES_N8
        print(f"  Using default N=8 model names (no coord in idata)")
